title: Yelin group meditation: synchronized binaural session with about 30 people and orb contact

tellings.quote: So what that looked like is I took a group of about 30 people.

plain: About 30 people meditated together outdoors at a place called Yelin, all listening to the same binaural sound (two slightly different tones, one in each ear) at once, and are said to have made contact with glowing orbs. Jordan Jose, who says he was taken into a UFO program as a child, tells this as a session he led. In his words: "I took a group of about 30 people."
